evidence: Frozen task/task.toml:20-24 sets network_mode="public", cpus=2 and memory_mb=4096, with no environment secrets, docker_image or allow_internet; parsed environment values exactly match the frozen template. These are sensible resources for the supplied Node/Express/SQLite app. environment/Dockerfile:1-26 is byte-identical to the frozen template, preinstalls Express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1, and copies only reviewed instructions/assets. No secret literals occur in those staged files. The workbook Internal Quality Checks row 10 still says no-network; its current Quality Checks row 10 and skill explicitly supersede that historical annotation with public networking. Verified all 14 current_agent_image artifact hashes against raw-evidence-index.json and all 8 source-binding hashes against current frozen files. agent-image/build-stderr.log:53-57 records the matching image build; smoke-command.json:3-15 and smoke-stdout.log:1 show successful native SQLite and Express HTTP operations without network, plus exact staged-file hashes. image-inspect-stdout.log:10-16 contains only PATH, NODE_VERSION, YARN_VERSION and NODE_PATH environment values. This smoke is dependency evidence, not a resource-limited full builder/judge run; row 9 does not require those separate measurements. A broken image missing native SQLite would fail smoke.js:33-39; a conforming app using CDN editor assets remains allowed by integration.md:13 and policy.md:7, so it is not falsely rejected for public networking.
